Why Lewisville businesses miss calls

Lewisville sits on I-35E near DFW Airport, and nearly one in five workers is in professional or business services. Lake traffic adds a seasonal layer in warm months, when marinas, boat repair shops and restaurants all get busier at once. Small companies here compete with larger firms across Denton and Dallas counties, so answering first can matter more than having the biggest ad budget.

Which Lewisville businesses benefit most?

  • Dental offices: Commuters often call at lunch, when your front desk is busiest.
  • Auto repair shops: Book service visits for drivers on I-35E.
  • Restaurants: Lake weekends bring repeat questions about hours and tables.

Can you keep your Lewisville phone number?

Yes. Lewisville callers will usually see the 214, 469, 972 and 945 area codes, and you can keep the number customers already know. Forward it to the AI for all calls, only after hours, or only when your team does not pick up. We can also set up a new local number. Everything is set up remotely, so you do not need new equipment or a visit to an office.

What to check before you go live

  1. Test real calls: ask awkward questions, not only easy ones, and listen to how it handles them.
  2. Set the rules: decide which calls transfer to a person and which become messages.
  3. Plan your minutes: estimate your busiest month, not an average one.
  4. Tell callers what you need to: Texas is generally treated as a one-party consent state for recording calls, but rules differ for callers in other states, so check with your advisor if you record calls.
